question: Who from Pakistan was recognised as Best Asian Athlete in May 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arshad Nadeem**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Arshad Nadeem**, a prominent athlete from **Pakistan**, was recognized as the **Best Asian Athlete in May 2025** due to his exceptional achievements in the field of athletics.
 
• He specializes in the **javelin throw** and has consistently brought laurels to Pakistan with his remarkable performances in international sporting events.
 
• Arshad Nadeem became a household name after his **gold medal win at the 2023 World Athletics Championships**, where he set a new personal and national record.
 
• He also secured a **historic silver medal** at the **2024 Paris Olympics**, marking Pakistan's first-ever Olympic medal in athletics.
 
• His recognition as the **Best Asian Athlete** is a testament to his dedication, hard work, and ability to compete at the highest level, elevating Pakistan's profile in global athletics.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Arshad Nadeem:**

 
 
• Born on **January 2, 1997**, in **Mian Channu, Punjab, Pakistan**.
 
• Arshad holds the distinction of being the first athlete from Pakistan to directly qualify for the **Olympics in athletics**.
 
• His personal best throw of **90.18 meters** in javelin came during the **2023 World Athletics Championships**.
 
• He trained under the guidance of **Fayyaz Bukhari** and received support from the **Pakistan Sports Board**.
 
• Arshad is known for his resilience, having overcome injuries to continue performing at the top level.
 
 
 
• **Other notable Pakistani athletes:**
 
 
• **Sana Mir:** Former captain of the Pakistan women's cricket team, a pioneer in women's cricket in Pakistan.
 
• **Babar Azam:** Current captain of the Pakistan men's cricket team and one of the world's best batsmen.
 
• **Mohammad Abbas:** A key player in Pakistan's cricket team, known for his consistent performances as a fast bowler.
 
 
 
• **Javelin Throw:**
 
 
• A field event in track and field athletics where athletes attempt to throw a spear-like implement as far as possible.
 
• Requires a combination of strength, speed, and technique for optimal performance.
 
• The javelin must be thrown overhand and land tip-first within the designated sector.
 
 
 
• **Asian Athletics Recognition:**
 
 
• The **Best Asian Athlete** award is a prestigious recognition given by the **Asian Athletics Association (AAA)**.
 
• It honors athletes who exhibit outstanding performances in international competitions, breaking records or achieving significant milestones.
 
• Arshad Nadeem’s recognition highlights Pakistan’s growing prominence in Asian athletics.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Arshad Nadeem's Achievements:**

 
 
• First Pakistani to win a **gold medal** in the **Commonwealth Games** javelin throw event (2022).
 
• Winner of multiple medals in **Asian Games** and other international championships.
 
 
 
• **Impact on Sports in Pakistan:**
 
 
• Arshad's achievements have inspired a new generation of athletes in Pakistan, particularly in track and field events.
 
• His success has led to increased investment in athletics infrastructure and training programs in the country.
